texts: On day 380 of Year 2, Coraline Ash lit the lantern of the Harbor Station at sundown.
The lantern showed mist-light at night.
A crowd of nightmoths gathered at the Harbor Row.
Two sky-cats descended from the cliff-spires.
The two sky-cats hunted the nightmoth crowd at the Harbor Row.
The nightmoth crowd at the Harbor Row shrank.
The nightmoths left silken threads on the lantern.
Coraline Ash collected the silken threads from the lantern at dawn on day 381 of Year 2.
Hesper boiled the silken threads in sea-water on day 381 of Year 2.
Mire-essence formed in a cauldron by evening.
Coraline Ash drew the stored mire-essence at sundown on day 381 of Year 2.

q1_issues.issue: "at the Harbor Row" is dropped from the hunting clause entirely - neither (Location sk_hunt_1 harbor_row) on the event nor an entity-attached position atom on the crowd is emitted.
the restrictor in "the nightmoth crowd at the Harbor Row shrank" is likewise dropped, so a stated locative restriction goes unrecorded for a second time.
harbor_station gets its Name atom but no (Member harbor_station station) type atom, although the kind word sits inside the name (same omission for harbor_row at statement 35).
"left silken threads on the lantern" deposits the threads without altering them, so the object should be Theme, not Patient (the same role error is copied into the per-member rule at statement 66).

q2_gaps: verb/noun homonymy under lemmatization: the lighting event class (Member sk_light_1 light) and the illumination kind (Inheritance mist_light light) collapse onto one symbol `light`, and the instruction set offers no sense-distinguishing mechanism
review.notes: The group/count encoding, the per-member distribution rules for the distributive plural subjects, the deadline "by evening" as TimeAtMost, and "stored" kept as a participial adjective are all handled per the instruction set. The recurring defect is the silently dropped "at the Harbor Row" locative.

issues.reason: Core patterns bars silently dropping a stated restriction, and a licensed form exists under either attachment — `(Location sk_hunt_1 harbor_row)` on the event, or `(LocatedIn sk_crowd_1 harbor_row)` on the crowd, since 'at' is in LocatedIn's containment list — yet the parse emits neither, so the crowd's position reaches the KB nowhere (the gather event's own Location does not attach to the crowd).

The half that stands is that the locative is again unrecorded; the half that is overstated is 'a second time' — the NP is an anaphoric definite already resolved to sk_crowd_1, so this restates the same fact as issue 0 and one `(LocatedIn sk_crowd_1 harbor_row)` atom discharges both clauses, and its absence here widens no claim on its own.

Names and casing mandates the type atom when the kind word sits inside the name — 'the Kestrel River' → `(Member kestrel_river river)` beside the Name — so `(Member harbor_station station)` and `(Member harbor_row row)` are licensed and required, and omitting them leaves both named places untyped.

'Left silken threads on the lantern' deposits the threads without altering them, which is the Theme side of the 'does the object itself change?' test (and the unclear-case default is Theme anyway), so `(Patient sk_leave_1 sk_silken_threads_1)` asserts a change the sentence does not state, in the flat atom and in the per-member rule alike.

gaps_confirmed: verb/noun homonymy survives lemmatization: the lighting event class `(Member sk_light_1 light)` and the illumination kind `(Inheritance mist_light light)` collapse onto one symbol `light`, and the instruction set supplies no sense index or other disambiguating mechanism
new_gaps: a bare MASS subject of an episodic clause ('Mire-essence formed in a cauldron by evening') has no stated routing: the episodic bare-plural rule mints a group witness, but a mass has no members, so nothing says whether it takes a witness or the bare class constant — here the same substance ends up under two symbols in one parse, the witness `sk_mire_essence_1` as subject and the bare constant `mire_essence` as the burn event's object, with no link between them
adjudication.defect_summary: Issue 0: the compliant form is the stated locative carried as `(LocatedIn sk_crowd_1 harbor_row)` on the crowd (the reading the following sentence's identical NP selects), or `(Location sk_hunt_1 harbor_row)` if the PP is read as an event adjunct. Issue 2: the compliant form adds `(Member harbor_station station)` and `(Member harbor_row row)` beside the existing Name atoms. Issue 3: the compliant form is `(Theme sk_leave_1 sk_silken_threads_1)`, with the same substitution inside the per-member rule at index 66.
adjudication.notes: The per-member rules copy the shared object into each member's event, which is exactly the prescribed 'Three students passed the exam' shape and not a defect. Item aside from the four issues, the roles, the group/count encoding, the 'by evening' TimeAtMost and the participial 'stored' all follow the instruction set.
